state.task: Choose an architecture and discriminating study for an API-model autonomous investigation system. No weight training. Human mission, external authority, and independent acceptance remain outside learned code. This is design work, not a claim of RSI.
observed: Existing broker, journal, child executor, STEP artifacts, proposal/freezing, policy assessment and exact binding exist. Worker reports 133 focused checks. Last live bundle independently fails offline verification on seven empty receipt sets; cause not isolated. Study P1/P2 unavailable, no comparison verdict.

trajectory.run_campaign loops over assigned tasks. policy_assess._run_arm has a separate effect implementation: request_model refused, only seed or supplied methods execute, state resets for each task. It therefore does not measure an improver learning over a trajectory.

construct_policy is host-selected when a STEP proposal requests revision. Runtime can replace STEP but has not shown an inherited improver controlling construction and assessment of later descendants.
Both existing task families concern reduction; their presence does not prove broad transfer. The roadmap is stale. Some implementation and experimental correctness remains unreviewed.

alternatives.A: Keep fixed episode controllers, expose many separate pluggable cognitive policies. Cheap but host retains agenda and improvement sequence; module interactions hard to assess.
alternatives.B: Persistent investigations plus a versioned executable program with operational and improvement modes, using one admitted action executor. Program can choose reads, probes, construction, repair, archive parents, evidence gathering and stopping. A revision may change its own improvement mode. Small trusted runtime owns effects, identity, authority and independently configured assessment. Code and state versions pinned at episode boundaries. This is selected.
alternatives.C: Whole repository agent population with independent self-editing runtimes and evaluator co-evolution. Broad search but expensive comparability and containment; no evidence now that more writable runtime is limiting discovery. Defer this scope.

state.mechanisms: Evidence is immutable observations plus revisable claims, archive of scoped executable methods/programs, and working state. Dependency references allow invalidation, not claimed causal proof. Background learning runs on events or authorized idle slices, with a heartbeat only for wake/recovery. Replay is supported only for compatible recorded action-context transitions; missing outcomes are unknown. Predictive simulations are separately labeled and cannot promote alone. Archive retains limited experimental alternatives separately from executable defaults. User mission cannot be rewritten. Domain adapters define instruments and judges, not the cognitive loop.
state.evaluation: First make operation attempts attributable, preserving unknown liability rather than inventing receipts or zero costs. Then show one persistent program selecting experiments and learning across software reduction and a finite Boolean-rule discovery domain. Use the same production effects under separate private development/assessment sessions. P0 is competent fixed policy, P1 is program constructed without history, P2 with history; P1/P2 have equal reserved construction allowance, model and primitive access. Retain cost of failures and construction. Pre-register practical gain and regression bounds and do not treat low-powered pilots as significant. Test actual improver inheritance by restarting old and revised improvers from identical base solvers and archive on fresh tasks under equal budgets, freezing the improvers during that comparison. Probe context/agenda/replay mechanisms with focused ablations rather than factorial explosion. No candidate is unavailable, not an empirical null. Live scope stays within verified existing authority; a proposal grants nothing.
state.risks: Meta-evaluation expensive; making program self-editable is not evidence it becomes a better improver. Fixed baseline must solve nontrivial tasks. State needs explicit migration or reset on program replacement. Assessment feedback exposure must be tracked to prevent repeated holdout reuse. New theory is a conditional operational model, not convergence proof.

architecture.instructions: Which alternative best serves the stated goal now, given the implementation evidence and finite resources? Evaluate architectural fit, not smallest diff.

criteria.A: Fixed host with independently replaceable component policies
criteria.B: Persistent investigation and an editable operational/improvement program over a stable effect runtime

meta_identification.instructions: Does the proposed old-versus-revised improver comparison distinguish inherited improvement ability from carrying a stronger starting solver, if implemented as specified?

criteria.true: Yes, conditional on equal starting solvers, archive, evidence, model, budget and frozen improver
criteria.false: No, a material confound remains in the stated design
